(iv) For any other writ/writs, order/orders for which petitioner deemed Patna High Court CWJC No.2204 of 2023(8) dt.11-03-2024 entitled to."
3.
Earlier on 21.02.2024, learned State counsel submitted that a supplementary counter-affidavit has been filed on 16.02.2023.
4. As the same was not on record, the Office was directed to locate it and attach the same with the file.

5. By office note dated 05.03.2024, it has been incorporated as follows:
"No Supplementary Counter Affidavit filed as yet as per computer at flag "A".
However, A rejoinder of the petitioner to Counter of respondents filed on 17.02.2024 filed and kept with record.
Submitted before the Hon'ble Bench U/H for Admission."

6. This Court has also checked the website and has found that no supplementary counter-affidavit is on record, as such, a cost of Rs. 2,000/- is imposed upon the office of the learned GP-18 to be paid to the learned counsel for the petitioner within a period of two weeks.

7. Learned counsel for the petitioner was informed that in the latest affidavit, which is not on record,
in paragraph- Patna High Court CWJC No.2204 of 2023(8) dt.11-03-2024 6, they have accepted that the name of the petitioners still running and as such, he has made a prayer for cancellation of the jamabandi.

8. As per the copy of the supplementary counter- affidavit provided by the learned counsel paragraph-6 of the said affidavit signed by the Circle Officer, Hanuman Nagar, Darbhanga read as follows:
"That as the RSP no. 136 is recorded as Anavad Sarv Sadhran in R.S. Khatiyan, hence the Circle Officer, Hanumannagar forwarded a proposal, for cancellation of the above Jamabandi, running in the name of above petitioners, vide letter no. 140 dated 27/02/2023, alongwith report of the KC and the copy of Register-II."
9.

In that background, the writ petition is disposed of directing the petitioner to appear in the said jamabandi cancellation case, the number of which has still not been incorporated in the supplementary counter-affidavit, if such jamabandi cancellation is filed by the State, naturally Dilip Kumar Mishra vs The State Of Bihar on 11 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/164397410/
